Golden Visa

The Golden Visa cost varies based on factors. The factors include the investment amount, property ownership, or specific qualifications. Generally, a Golden Visa UAE is a premium visa with higher fees compared to other visa types, offering several UAE Golden Visa benefits that make it a preferred choice for eligible applicants.

Freelance Visa

The UAE freelance visa cost depends on the free zone where it is issued and the specific services offered. Typically, this visa type includes:

  • Visa processing fees

  • Other related expenses.

Family visa

The family visa cost in UAE varies based on the relationship with the sponsor, the emirate, and the visa duration. The family visa cost in Dubai includes:

  • Visa processing fees
  • Medical tests, and
  • Emirates ID charges.

Process for work visa and permit UAE

The process for a work visa and permit in UAE includes whole procedure to follow. Here, we explore the procedure for the work visa and permit UAE:

Eligibility Criteria

Obtaining a work visa and permit in the UAE requires several steps. Firstly, you need to meet the eligibility criteria to apply for a UAE visa. For instance, you typically need:

  • A valid job offer from a UAE-based company.
  • A specific occupation listed on the in-demand occupations list.
  • A valid passport.
  • Good health as confirmed by a medical examination.

Required documents

For the UAE visa, the document requirements may vary. It depends on the employer and work visa type. The list of documents include:

  • Passport copy.
  • Employment contract.
  • Educational certificates.
  • Medical report.
  • Passport-sized photos.

Costs Involved in Obtaining a UAE Work Visa and Permit

It is essential to pay the required costs to seamlessly obtain your UAE visa. The UAE work visa and permit costs include:

  • Visa application fees.
  • Medical examination fees.
  • Emirates ID fees.
  • Employment visa cost in UAE.
  • Potential agency fees.

Important Note:

Note that, these costs can vary depending on the emirate and the specific circumstances. However, we share the important components on which the costs depend.

Tips for a Successful UAE Work Visa Application

Everyone wants a stress-free experience. You can achieve it so by following the tips. Here, we share tips for a Successful UAE Work Visa Application:

Thorough Research:

First, you must understand the specific visa requirements for your occupation and the emirate you plan to work in. Without knowing the details, you can’t plan and process things accordingly.

Accurate Documentation:

Before starting, you must ensure that all required documents are complete, accurate, and up-to-date. This step is necessary for a seamless visa experience.

Timely Submission:

Submit your application in advance of your planned start date to allow for processing time. Timely submission will provide you with enough time to plan things accordingly. So, it is wise to plan before the date.

Clear Communication:

It is essential to maintain clear communication with your employer throughout the visa process. This step is of utmost importance. Unclear communication with your employer makes the process complicated. This leads to delays in the visa process.

Visa Agent:

If you don’t know the prerequisites of the visa application, consider using a reputable visa agent for assistance. Expats usually take this step when they are unfamiliar with the process. It’s an optional tip, you can skip it anyway.

Follow Up:

The last step is very important in the whole procedure. That is, to regularly check your application status and follow up with the relevant authorities if needed.

These are the tips that increase your chances for a quick visa approval. By following these tips, you can increase your chances of a successful UAE work visa application.
